name: Remix: PROJECT AHANG · MVP Preview login
description: PROJECT AHANG（白狮阿杭计划）是一项以动物个体数字档案为核心的公益项目，通过公众共同记录、科学整理与长期保存，为每一只值得被记住的动物建立持续更新的生命档案。本版本为 MVP Preview，仅用于产品体验与功能验证。PROJECT AHANG is a digital archive project dedicated to preserving the life stories of individual animals through public participation, scientific documentation, and long-term archiving. This is an MVP Preview for product validation.
